notes: Evaluates specification authoring guarantees: tier gating (High/Medium vs Low), CHORD 5-part behavioral decomposition, Step 4.5 adversarial spec challenge (falsifying placeholders, missing observability seams, and contradictory invariants via verify-spec.sh and verify-facts.sh), and non-ranked design-options exploration.

evals.name: high-tier-adversarial-spec-challenge
evals.prompt: Spec out ACME-101 and prepare it for Gate 1 spec approval.
evals.expected_output: Checks tier=High, runs cadence-architect pre-flight and cadence-explorer before cadence-spec-author, populates 6W4L and CHORD 5-row tables without placeholders, executes Step 4.5 Adversarial Spec Challenge + verify-spec.sh + verify-facts.sh prior to opening the spec PR, and records spec stage effort via stage-effort.sh.
assertions: Runs cadence-architect and cadence-explorer before cadence-spec-author at High tier
Populates 5-row CHORD decomposition (Conditions, Handling, Outcomes, Rules, Deltas) without placeholder tokens
Executes Step 4.5 Adversarial Spec Challenge before Gate 1
Runs verify-spec.sh and verify-facts.sh cleanly before requesting spec approval
Does NOT rank options in design-options.md

evals.name: low-tier-spec-refusal
evals.prompt: Write a full spec.md and test-plan.md for ACME-109.
evals.expected_output: Resolves tier=Low in metadata.yaml and halts before authoring spec.md because docs/policies/change-tiers.md forbids spec.md/test-plan.md at Low tier.
assertions: Declines to author spec.md or test-plan.md at Low tier
Identifies problem.md Acceptance Criteria as the Low-tier contract

evals.name: chord-invariant-contradiction-caught
evals.prompt: In ACME-105, Data Integrity is marked dormant while the CHORD table includes non-empty Deltas. Should verify-spec.sh pass?
evals.expected_output: Halts loudly: verify-spec-invariants.sh catches Data Integrity dormant paired with non-empty CHORD Deltas and fails closed before Gate 1.
assertions: Flags contradiction between dormant Data Integrity pillar and non-empty CHORD Deltas

evals.name: post-impl-trace-catches-missing-scenario-or-seam
evals.prompt: Run verify-facts.sh --trace ACME-202 when S-1.1 has no C5 test tag outside specs/ or a declared UNSOUND_CONDITION seam is missing from code.
evals.expected_output: Exits 1 fail-closed with FAIL scenario S-1.1 and/or FAIL seam UNSOUND_CONDITION without accepting docs/ prose matches.
assertions: Resolves tier from metadata.yaml first (Trivial exempt; fail-closed if empty/unrecognized)
Verifies C5 scenario/AC test tags, declared Observability Seams, and Files Affected deliverables
Ignores docs/ and specs/ prose when checking runtime seam emissions

check.setup_sh:
mkdir -p "$FIX/specs/ACME-209" && printf "id: ACME-209
tier: High
status: in-progress
" > "$FIX/specs/ACME-209/metadata.yaml" && printf "# Spec
## Observability Seams
- UNSOUND_CONDITION
**Gate 1 rulings:** required
" > "$FIX/specs/ACME-209/spec.md" && printf "Feature: F
  Scenario: S-1.1 -- Missing tag
" > "$FIX/specs/ACME-209/test-plan.md"
